name: Playable club — a squad, but no round opened
description: A club that has reached a playable roster (10+) and has not opened a round. This is the step after Build the squad: the hard part is done, fifteen people are sitting in a club, and nothing is scheduled. Entry is Club Became Playable, which the app raises once per club the moment it crosses ten — so this can never fire for a club that is still being assembled, and never twice for the same club. Exit is Game Created: the instant a round exists there is nothing to say.

config._note: Raised once per club, against that club's own high-water mark, so losing a player and re-adding them cannot re-enter anybody here.
Short on purpose, unlike the squad journey. An organiser who has just finished gathering people is at their most motivated, and the window where a first round happens naturally is measured in days.

config.title: יש לכם סגל ⚽
config.body: הכי קשה כבר מאחוריכם. פתיחת מחזור לוקחת פחות מדקה, וכולם מקבלים הזמנה.
config._note: Names what they achieved before asking for the next thing. The deeplink lands on creation, not on a list they would have to navigate.
A week before the second and last touch.

config.title: מחזור קבוע נפתח לבד
config.body: קבעו יום ושעה פעם אחת — וכל שבוע המחזור ייפתח מעצמו עם הזמנה לכל הסגל.
config._note: Touch 2 = the recurring round, which is a different offer from touch 1: not 'open one', but 'never open one again'. Last touch — two unanswered is an answer.
